skills.content:
# AmbientOS System Guide

AmbientOS is an AI-powered company orchestration platform where 8 autonomous agents run departments under human (CEO) governance. The system operates on a **propose -> approve -> execute -> audit** cycle, with a heartbeat that fires every hour (configurable in `function.json`, was 30 min before Claude Sonnet switch).

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of the platform and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block._

### 2026-04-12
- **Full skill injection system** deployed. The heartbeat now reads full skill content (up to 6KB per skill, Gemini-tuned) instead of 1KB regex-filtered fragments. Content agents see all 6 product skills; ops agents see only ambientos-guide. Agents should reference product facts from skill content as canonical source.
- **Founder voice system** deployed (recent activity digest + corpus + doctrine). Scribe sees last 48h completed tasks + current follower counts + 10 example posts rotated per heartbeat. Hard voice rules: no em dashes, no buzzwords, lowercase casual, 5th grade reading level, authentic over polished.
- **Bluesky reply pipeline** built (Scout discovery → Scribe drafts → CEO approval). New task types: `bluesky_discovery` (Scout), `bluesky_reply` (Scribe). New approval queue kind: `bluesky_reply`. Runs via `camp-bluesky-discovery` campaign, daily cadence. Uses AT Protocol reply payload (root/parent uri+cid).
- **Quality gate** now auto-rejects failed posts (>=70% confidence) and feeds specific issues back to Scribe. Failed posts never reach the approval queue. Scribe sees the issues in a system comment and rewrites on the next cycle.
- **Dead systems removed:** workers, planner/calibration, priority engine, action router/executors/queue (~8,300 lines deleted). All were client-side browser loops disabled by default. **Do not reference them in any prompt or action.** They do not exist.
- **New objective** `obj-founder-voice` ("Build in Public Presence") for build-in-public growth. Goal: Bluesky 24 → 200 followers in 90 days. Linked to `camp-bluesky-discovery`.
- **Bluesky credentials** live in Azure env vars (`BLUESKY_HANDLE`, `BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD`), NOT in `socialCredentials` state key.

### 2026-04-11
- **Needs Attention** now shows convergence escalations only. Overdue and stale revision escalations removed — they were agent execution concerns, not CEO action items. Only "agent failed 5+ times on a deliverable" surfaces now.
- **Form intake tasks** now created with `status: 'todo'` (was `'open'` which agents could not process). All future inbound contact + draft reply tasks now flow normally.
- **Campaign auto-replenish** sets default due dates based on cadence (daily=1d, weekly=3d, biweekly=5d).
- **CEO revision safety net** extended to in-progress tasks. Previously only reset `done`/`review` tasks — now also clears stale `_social_action_created` flag on in-progress tasks so agents re-engage.
- **Research brief dedup** fixed. Trends radar auto-brief now dedups against done tasks within 30 days, not just active tasks. No more duplicate briefs per trend.

_Entries older than 30 days are condensed into the main skill body below. This changelog is surfaced to the top of every heartbeat injection — keep it tight._

## Quick Orientation

**Brand hierarchy:** AmbientPixels (company) -> AmbientOS (platform) -> AmbientScore (product)

**All code lives under `ambientpixels/`** — not at the repo root. This is the #1 mistake new sessions make.

### Key Directories
| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `ambientpixels/api/` | Azure Functions (Node.js) — 88+ endpoints |
| `ambientpixels/api/companyHeartbeat/` | Heartbeat engine — 15 modules, ~6500 lines total |
| `ambientpixels/api/company-state/` | State storage layer (Azure Blob + local fallback) |
| `ambientpixels/modules/company/` | Dashboard UI (20+ HTML pages) |
| `ambientpixels/css/` | 36 CSS files, hand-written, theme token system |
| `ambientpixels/data/` | Static config (agents, actions, manifests) |
| `ambientpixels/docs/` | 53 documentation files |
| `ambientpixels/nova/` | Nova public pages |

### Infrastructure
- **Hosting:** Azure Static Web Apps (static) + Azure Functions (API)
- **Function App:** `ambientpixels-nova-api`, resource group `ambientpixelsV2`
- **Storage:** Azure Blob (`cardforgeblobdata` account, `company-state` container)
- **Auth:** Azure B2C CIAM
- **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions -> deploy on push to master
- **AI:** Claude Sonnet 4.6 (heartbeat agents — switchable via `HEARTBEAT_MODEL` env var, default=gemini) + Gemini 2.0 Flash (image gen, fallback) + Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Pixel Agents, Agent Forge)
- **Search:** Brave Search API (web search agents)

---

# AmbientScore Development Skill

AmbientScore is AmbientPixels' standalone AI website conversion audit product. Users enter a URL, get an instant 0-100 score with a letter grade, see 3 teaser findings for free, and can unlock the full report ($49 single / $149 3-pack). The product lives at `/ambientscore/` and is self-contained — its own CSS, JS, and API layer.

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of AmbientScore and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

_No recent entries. CEO: add dated bullet points here as AmbientScore evolves (scoring model changes, new dimensions, pricing tweaks, report layout updates, credit pack changes, etc.)._

## Architecture Overview

### Frontend Pages

| Page | File | Purpose |
|------|------|---------|
| Landing | `ambientscore/index.html` + `js/ambientscore.js` | URL input, free scan results, upgrade CTA |
| Report | `ambientscore/report.html` + `js/report.js` | Full report viewer with paywall logic |
| Strategy | `ambientscore/strategy.html` + `js/strategy.js` | Lead capture intake form |
| Confirm | `ambientscore/confirm.html` | Slot booking confirmation |

### API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `/api/as-analyze` | POST | Core scan — accepts `{ url }` or `{ sessionId }` (payment verification) |
| `/api/as-report` | GET | Report retrieval — `?id=<reportId>`, returns teaser or full based on unlock status |
| `/api/as-credits` | POST | Credit check (`action: "check"`) or redemption (`action: "redeem"`) |
| `/api/as-confirm` | POST | Strategy session confirmation with HMAC validation |
| `/api/formIntake` | POST | Shared intake — type `"ambientscore_strategy"` for strategy submissions |

### Library Modules (`api/_lib/ambientScore/`)

| Module | Role |
|--------|------|
| `analyzer.js` | Pipeline orchestrator — scrape → extract → classify → evaluate → score → synthesize |
| `scraper.js` | URL fetching with SSRF protection, cheerio HTML parsing |
| `dimensions.js` | 8-dimension model definition, weight profiles by site type, scoring helpers |
| `promptBuilder.js` | Gemini prompt templates for each pipeline stage |
| `scorer.js` | Deterministic scoring — decompression curve (1→0, 5→60, 10→100) |
| `reportRenderer.js` | HTML report template generation |
| `creditUtils.js` | Pack credit ledger (purchase/redeem history per email hash) |
| `stripeClient.js` | Stripe checkout creation, session verification, webhook signatures |
| `emailSender.js` | Azure Communication Services email delivery |

## The 8-Dimension Scoring Model

The scoring model is the intellectual core of the product. It lives in `dimensions.js` and drives everything from prompt construction to report rendering.

### Group A — Conversion Funnel (55% base weight)

1. **Messaging Clarity** (15%) — Headline clarity, value prop specificity, jargon avoidance, consistency
2. **CTA Strength** (15%) — Visibility, action language, value alignment, placement
3. **Funnel Friction** (15%) — Step count, cognitive load, form optimization, distractions
4. **Conversion Hierarchy** (10%) — Visual hierarchy, information flow, progressive disclosure

### Group B — Trust & Differentiation (45% base weight)

5. **Trust Signals** (15%) — Social proof quality, authority markers, risk reversal, transparency
6. **Differentiation** (10%) — Unique mechanism, competitor contrast, category ownership
7. **Audience Alignment** (10%) — Language match, pain point addressing, sophistication calibration
8. **Quick-Win Fixes** (10%) — Low-hanging fruit count, implementation ease

Each dimension has 3-4 sub-criteria. Gemini scores each sub-criterion 1-10, then the decompression curve maps LLM scores to 0-100 (because LLMs compress scores toward 5-7, a raw 5 maps to 60, not 50). Weights are dynamic — `dimensions.js` has profiles for SaaS, enterprise, ecommerce, content, media, local service, and agency site types.

### When modifying the scoring model

- Adding a dimension: update `dimensions.js` (definition + weights for ALL site-type profiles), `promptBuilder.js` (evaluation prompts for the correct group), `scorer.js` (if weight math changes), and `reportRenderer.js` (display).
- Changing weights: only touch `dimensions.js`. The scorer reads weights from there.
- Changing the decompression curve: only touch `scorer.js`. The curve parameters are there.

skills.content:
# CardForge Development Reference

CardForge is a browser-based RPG card creator with 40M+ visual combinations, AI generation, deck building, and a public gallery. It's a **pure card creator** — the arena battle system was removed in April 2026 (Blindspot handles combat). It runs as a static frontend on Azure Static Web Apps with Azure Functions APIs and Azure Blob storage.

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of CardForge and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

### 2026-04
- **Arena battle system removed.** CardForge is now a pure card creator. All arena endpoints, combat logic, and PvP references are gone. Blindspot handles combat as a standalone game. Do NOT reference arena features, battles, or PvP when writing about CardForge.

_CEO: add more dated bullet points here as CardForge evolves (new presets, editor features, gallery changes, etc.)._

## Quick Orientation

**Frontend:** `ambientpixels/cardforge/` — ~24 JS modules, ~17 CSS files
**APIs:** `ambientpixels/api/cardforge*` — 14 Azure Function endpoints (arena endpoints removed)
**Storage:** Azure Blob `cardforgeblobdata` container `cardforge`
**Entry point:** `cardforge/index.html` — editor page
**Decks:** `cardforge/deck.html` — deck builder

## Architecture Overview

```
Browser (Static Web App)
├── index.html ──→ Card Editor (create/edit/save/publish cards)
│   ├── card-forge-editor.js — core editor engine
│   ├── cardforge-forge-actions.js — save/publish/delete
│   ├── cardforge-quick-build.js — 5-step wizard
│   ├── cardforge-ai.js — Gemini AI generation
│   └── ~20 more modules...
└── deck.html ──→ Deck Builder
    └── cardforge-deck-builder.js

Azure Functions API (14 endpoints)
├── Card CRUD: load, save, delete, publish
├── Deck CRUD: load, publish, delete
├── Billing: entitlements, checkout, webhook, portal
└── Sharing: cardshare, deckshare (OG meta)

Azure Blob Storage (cardforgeblobdata/cardforge/)
├── user/{userId}/cards.json — personal cards
├── published-cards.json — gallery index
├── published-decks-index.json — deck gallery
├── published-decks/{shareId}.json — individual decks
└── billing/entitlements/{userId}.json — subscription
```

## Key Concepts

### 6-Tier Modular Design System
Cards are styled through 6 composable layers stored in `ModularState`:
1. **Presets** — 10 curated starting points (hero-classic, split-modern, etc.)
2. **Image Container** — masked/fullbleed/polaroid/banner/floating + variants
3. **Color Palette** — neon/earth/ocean/fire/cosmic/sunset/monochrome + light/dark/vibrant
4. **Content Alignment** — horizontal/vertical/weight/style
5. **Effects** — bg (foil/holographic), border (thick/double/img-gold/img-arcane/img-royal), glow (neon/pulse), image filters
6. **Typography** — font family, text color (auto/light/dark)

### Combat Stats (Uncapped)
5 core stats: STR, AGI, INT, END, LCK (0-100 scale each, independent).
**No budget cap** — each stat is set freely 0-100 (300-point budget removed April 2026).
Legacy card stats are mapped via aliases (e.g., "agility" → AGI, "wisdom" → INT).

### Effect Tiers (All Unlocked)
`effect-tiers.js` was removed. A shim in `config.js` (`window.EffectTiers`) provides all methods the editor calls, with everything unlocked:
- `isEffectUnlocked()` → always returns `true`
- `isBuffUnlocked()` → always returns `true`
- `getSlotCap()` → returns 4 (max)
- `getMaxBuffQty()` → returns 3 (max)
- `getUnlockedBuffs()` → returns all BUFF_DEFS
- `getUnlockedEffects()` → returns all effects
- `BUFF_DEFS` — 10 buff types (attack, defense, speed, heal, crit, luck, shield wall, berserker, regen, evasion)
- `EFFECT_TIERS` — full tier map (bronze through diamond) for effects

No rank gating, no progression — all visual effects and buffs are available to all users immediately.

### Image Border Frames
3 image-based border options wired into the Card Border chip selector:
- `img-gold` — Gold Filigree (`/cardforge/images/borders/border-gold-filigree.png`)
- `img-arcane` — Arcane Runes (`/cardforge/images/borders/border-arcane.png`)
- `img-royal` — Royal Ornate (`/cardforge/images/borders/border-royal.png`)

Applied via `::after` pseudo-element overlay (z-index 10, pointer-events none).
CSS in `cardforge-border-effects.css`. Classes: `.rarity-style-img-gold`, etc.

5 more border PNGs exist but aren't wired yet: frost, ember, shadow, nature, circuit.
All PNGs are 375x525px transparent PNG with 16px rounded corners.
Generator: `tools/border-generator.html` + `tools/border-capture.js` (Playwright screenshot).

To add a new image border:
1. Create PNG at 375x525px with transparent center + 16px border-radius
2. Save to `cardforge/images/borders/border-{name}.png`
3. Add `<option value="img-{name}">` to the hidden select in index.html
4. Add `<button class="effect-chip tier-option" data-value="img-{name}">` chip in index.html
5. Add CSS rule `.card-preview-canvas.rarity-style-img-{name}::after { background-image: url(...) }` to cardforge-border-effects.css
6. Add `'img-{name}'` to the `borderEffects` array in card-forge-editor.js

### Auth Flow
Azure SWA EasyAuth → `/.auth/me` → `clientPrincipal`.
Auth helper in `config.js`: `window._cfGetAuthHeaders()` fetches principal and returns `{ 'X-CF-Auth-Principal': JSON.stringify(principal) }`. Cached after first call.
CSRF tokens auto-injected on POST by `csrf-protection.js`.
Admin user: `5bb115c5-9077-4049-8af0-ce5085a9c315`.

### Image Flash Prevention
`updateFrontFace()` does full `innerHTML` rebuil

# Pixel Agents & Agent Forge Development Reference

Pixel Agents is an AI agent marketplace where users deploy specialized agents for one-shot tasks. Agent Forge is the visual builder that lets users create custom agents with AI-generated portraits. Both run on Azure Static Web Apps with Azure Functions APIs.

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of Pixel Agents and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

## Quick Orientation

**Pixel Agents Frontend:** `ambientpixels/pixel-agents/` — catalog, run, analytics pages
**Agent Forge Frontend:** `ambientpixels/agent-forge/` — visual card pipeline builder

**Agent Registry:** `ambientpixels/pixel-agents/data/pixel-agents.json` + `ambientpixels/api/_data/pixel-agents.json` (MUST stay in sync)

# StoryForge — Development Skill

StoryForge is an AI-powered interactive fiction game at `ambientpixels/storyforge/`. Players pick a genre, create a character via a 3-step wizard, then play through branching narratives with skill checks, inventory, companions, and AI-generated scene art + narration.
